title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Resilient Communities’ project in Pibor County in South Sudan, implemented by Oxfam through ICSP will directly reach 27,000 returnees, internally displaced persons and host communities. Oxfam will partner with government and CSOs to ensure that these conflict-affected communities especially women and youth will have improved resilience to protect, adopt and absorb shocks from all forms of disasters through integrated food security, climate resilience, gender, good governance and peace building interventions. IMPACT: IMPACT 3: Institutional systems to prevent and respond to shocks, conflict and crises are more inclusive and better informed by the needs, rights and vulnerabilities of those furthest behind.OUTCOMES: MICRO: Local groups preventing, mitigating and responding to shocks and crises are increasingly guided by risks, vulnerabilities and agency of communities
